rules_metadata.name: ecommerce_declarative_business_rules
rules_metadata.description: Declarative Business Rules Specification classifying Hard Constraints (100% mandatory mathematical invariants and temporal monotonicity) and Soft Constraints (recommended business boundaries and statistical thresholds).
rules_metadata.author: Code Candy Team - AI BI Dashboard

hard_constraints.name: Gross Sales Mathematical Invariant
hard_constraints.description: Gross sales must strictly equal quantity multiplied by unit selling price.
hard_constraints.error_message: gross_sales does not equal quantity * unit_price

hard_constraints.name: Discount Amount Range Boundary
hard_constraints.description: Discount amount cannot be negative and cannot exceed gross sales.
hard_constraints.error_message: discount_amount is negative or exceeds gross_sales

hard_constraints.name: Net Sales Mathematical Invariant
hard_constraints.description: Net sales must strictly equal gross sales minus promotional discount amount.
hard_constraints.error_message: net_sales does not equal gross_sales - discount_amount

hard_constraints.name: Positive Line Item Quantity
hard_constraints.description: Quantity purchased must be a positive integer >= 1.

hard_constraints.name: Non-Negative Unit Price
hard_constraints.description: Unit selling price must be non-negative.

hard_constraints.name: Product Price and Cost Non-Negative
hard_constraints.description: Product retail price and unit cost of goods sold (COGS) must be non-negative.

hard_constraints.name: Margin Rate Formula Invariant
hard_constraints.description: Margin rate must equal (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price.
hard_constraints.error_message: margin_rate is inconsistent with unit_price and unit_cost

hard_constraints.name: Order Payment Value Non-Negative
hard_constraints.description: Total payment amount for an order must be non-negative.

hard_constraints.name: Delivery Date Monotonicity
hard_constraints.description: Delivered customer timestamp must be chronological after order purchase timestamp.

hard_constraints.name: Consolidated Net Profit Formula Invariant
hard_constraints.expression: abs(net_profit - (gross_revenue - (cogs_total + marketing_spend + platform_fees_total + shipping_cost_total + tax_amount + operating_expenses))) <= 0.10
hard_constraints.repair_formula: gross_revenue - (cogs_total + marketing_spend + platform_fees_total + shipping_cost_total + tax_amount + operating_expenses)
hard_constraints.description: Net profit must equal gross revenue minus the sum of all direct and indirect expenses.
hard_constraints.error_message: net_profit does not equal gross_revenue minus total operating and direct expenses

hard_constraints.name: Marketing Funnel Volume Monotonicity
hard_constraints.expression: impressions >= clicks and clicks >= conversions and conversions >= 0
hard_constraints.description: Marketing ad funnel volumes must satisfy impressions >= clicks >= conversions >= 0.
hard_constraints.error_message: Marketing funnel ordering violated (expected impressions >= clicks >= conversions >= 0)

hard_constraints.name: Financial Expense Components Non-Negative
hard_constraints.expression: gross_revenue >= 0 and cogs_total >= 0 and marketing_spend >= 0 and platform_fees_total >= 0 and shipping_cost_total >= 0 and tax_amount >= 0 and operating_expenses >= 0
hard_constraints.description: Gross revenue and all individual expense categories must be non-negative.
hard_constraints.error_message: One or more financial ledger figures are negative

soft_constraints.name: Marketplace Commission Ratio Guard
soft_constraints.description: Marketplace commission fees typically do not exceed 35% of gross sales.
soft_constraints.error_message: High platform fee detected (> 35% of gross sales)

soft_constraints.name: High Promotional Discount Warning
soft_constraints.description: Promotional discounts exceeding 60% of gross sales may indicate extreme liquidation or margin compression.
soft_constraints.error_message: Extremely high discount applied (> 60% of gross sales)

soft_constraints.name: Extreme Loss Leader Guard
soft_constraints.description: Product cost of goods sold should not exceed 150% of retail selling price.
soft_constraints.error_message: Product unit cost exceeds 150% of selling price

soft_constraints.name: Target Minimum Profit Margin
soft_constraints.description: Product margin is recommended to stay above 5% baseline.

soft_constraints.name: Plausible Click-Through Rate (CTR) Boundary
soft_constraints.description: Digital ad Click-Through Rate (CTR) is expected to be under 35%.

soft_constraints.name: Plausible Conversion Rate (CR) Boundary
soft_constraints.description: Ad click-to-conversion rate is expected to be under 50%.

soft_constraints.name: Healthy COGS-to-Revenue Proportion
soft_constraints.description: Total COGS should ideally remain under 90% of gross revenue for profitability.
soft_constraints.error_message: COGS exceeds 90% of periodic gross revenue
